verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The added self-test support is sound and non-vacuous. It reads each real keepalive leg's repository and watch-list from the extracted workflow step, refuses missing or ambiguous repository identities, normalizes the self-repository consistently, pins the complete current source-to-target map independently of the collision assertion, and separately proves the collision detector with positive, negative, and cross-repository controls. The production assertion therefore fails both when a second watcher appears and when an expected watcher silently disappears. The checkout-wide workflow search supports the claimed three staleness-driven sources; the separately documented causal metrics publish dispatch is correctly excluded because it is not an independent stale-anchor reader. No trust check is weakened, no secret or workflow permission surface is expanded, and no reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff.
